lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white line segments visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section and increases in width toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines on the posterior third of the torso appear as dashed or abbreviated segments rather than continuous lines from the dorsal to ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 10-15 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: 4 spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron pattern visible on the bridge of the muzzle between the eyes; prominent white patch on the lower throat.
